Google: shopping search ad revenue collapses as agents skip SERPs entirely. 
Amazon: retail media margins and discovery control erode when neutral agents compare freely. 
eBay: search-driven marketplace traffic dries up against structured agent catalogs.

Winners: 
Shopify: clean product data and agent checkouts make it the preferred merchant platform. 
Meta: Muse captures massive shopping discovery volume as a primary agent interface. 
OpenAI: ChatGPT agents handle the bulk of research-to-purchase flows and data.
